description: KULIC Advisory Execution Toolkit Library. Purely mechanical, no AI and no calculation. For an Excel template: pass the id, the section (number or title from get_template) and rows as objects keyed by column name. Returns the rows in the template's column order, the exact cell for every value (for example F10) so the values can be written into the downloaded file, and notes: columns the file calculates are left out, unknown fields and values outside a dropdown are named, rows beyond the prepared rows are listed without a cell. For a Word template (master service agreement, NDA, SLA): pass the id and values keyed by placeholder text without brackets, for example { "Party A": "Muster GmbH" }; returns the text with these placeholders replaced and the list of placeholders still open. Nothing is stored. The result is a working draft, not legal advice.

id.description: Id of the template, T01 to T44.

language.description: Language of the notes. Default de.

rows.description: Excel templates: one object per row, keyed by column name as shown by get_template.

section.description: Excel templates: number or title of the table section as shown by get_template, for example '2' or 'COMMERCIAL RESPONSE TABLE'.

sheet.description: Excel templates with several sheets: name of the sheet, if the section number exists on more than one.

values.description: Word templates: placeholder text without brackets as key, replacement as value. A key may end with #2, #3 to address the second, third occurrence of a placeholder that appears several times.

name: fill_template
title: Fill a table section of an Excel template or the placeholders of a Word template with the user's own values
